info.name: Ask, Don't Assume (team)
info.description:
Every backend route and Socket.IO event, split by who uses it. Each request has saved **examples** (the dropdown at the top right of the response).

1. Start the backend (`docker compose up -d --build`) and load the demo data (`docker compose exec backend node seed.js`).
2. Check `baseUrl` in the collection's **Variables** tab.
3. Run **Deva → REST → Start session** first: it saves `{{session_id}}` for the other requests and the Socket.IO payloads.

item.name: Deva (frontend)
item.description:
The customer app (journey, mode bar, help panel, chat).

**REST** runs in Postman as normal. **Socket.IO** can't be saved in a collection file, so each event is a page of notes: open a Socket.IO request (**New → Socket.IO**, URL `{{baseUrl}}`, **Connect**) and copy the payloads from here.

item.name: REST
item.description: The customer app's calls, in journey order. Run them in order: **Start session** saves `{{session_id}}`.

request.description: Step 1. Nothing is stored. `passport_country`: HK, MY, ID or CN are eligible. If not eligible, show the message for `code` and end the session with outcome `not_eligible`.
When the applicant taps **Foreigner with e-passport**. Keep `session_id` in `sessionStorage`; every later call uses it. `preferences` is optional.

Send the full current settings whenever one changes. Allowed: `wording` standard / simple, `text_size` default / large / xlarge, `language` en / zh / ms. Also send the matching `event` (e.g. `wording_change:simple`) over Socket.IO.

The help panel's question box. The server adds the step and the applicant's settings itself, so send only these three fields. `question`: 1–300 characters.

- `type: ai_answer`: show `answer`.
- `type: preference_change`: ask *"Would you like…?"* and apply `action` / `value` only if they say yes.
- `fallback: true`: show the standard message and offer **Talk to a person**.

The **Answer** and **Preference change** examples show what the AI service returns when it's running.

response.name: Answer
response.body:
{
  "type": "ai_answer",
  "answer": "The chip is usually inside the back cover. Take your phone out of its case, place it flat on the back cover and hold still for a few seconds.",
  "fallback": false,
  "action": null,
  "value": null
}

response.name: Preference change (ask before applying)
response.body:
{
  "type": "preference_change",
  "answer": "Would you like me to increase the text size?",
  "fallback": false,
  "action": "increase_text_size",
  "value": "large"
}

request.description: Step 6. Show `reference` on the confirmation screen; it isn't stored.

`abandoned` when the applicant leaves, `not_eligible` when step 1 fails. `submitted` is only set by **Submit application**. Run after **Submit application** this returns 204 but changes the outcome, so use a new session if you want to keep it as submitted.

item.name: Socket.IO · send
item.description: Messages the customer app sends. Connect a Socket.IO request to `{{baseUrl}}` first.

item.name: send · join_session
item.description:
Send on **every** connect, so the app gets this session's chat messages (also after a refresh).

**Send** (event name `join_session`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}"
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Joined | `{"ok": true}` |

**Then:** if a chat is open, `handoff:history` arrives straight after.

item.name: send · event
item.description:
Log one action or signal during the journey. `type` is `category` or `category:value`, e.g. `page_view`, `error:NFC_READ_FAILED`, `friction:repeated_errors`, `wording_change:simple`, `offer_accepted`. Full list in `api-docs.md`.

**Send** (event name `event`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "page_id": "account.step3",
  "type": "error:NFC_READ_FAILED"
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Saved | `{"ok": true}` |
| Server-only type (e.g. `handoff_request`) | `{"ok": false, "error": "unknown_type"}` |
| Unknown session | `{"ok": false, "error": "unknown_session"}` |
| Missing `page_id` | `{"ok": false, "error": "invalid_event"}` |

**Then:** consoles get `insights:update`.

item.name: send · handoff:request
item.description:
**Talk to a person.** `share` holds only what the share preview showed the applicant; other fields are dropped.

**Send** (event name `handoff:request`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "page_id": "account.step3",
  "share": {
    "step_no": 3,
    "step_title": "Scan your passport chip",
    "trigger": "friction:repeated_errors",
    "last_error": "NFC_READ_FAILED",
    "failed_attempts": 2
  }
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Request sent (`staff_online: 0` → show "no staff online right now") | `{"ok": true, "handoff_no": 1, "staff_online": 1}` |
| A request is already open | `{"ok": false, "error": "already_open"}` |

**Then:** consoles get `handoff:new`; wait for `handoff:accepted`.

item.name: send · handoff:reply
item.description:
Applicant → staff chat message. 1–300 characters; ID-like numbers are replaced with `[hidden]`.

**Send** (event name `handoff:reply`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "text": "Still failing. My passport is A1234567"
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Sent | `{"ok": true}` |
| No open hand-off | `{"ok": false, "error": "not_open"}` |
| Empty text | `{"ok": false, "error": "bad_text"}` |

**Then:** both sides get `handoff:reply` (show your own message from it, not from the input box).

item.description:

**Example payload received:**

  "handoff_no": 1,
  "staff_name": "Sherry Lim",
  "messages": [

      "handoff_no": 1,
      "page_id": "account.step3",
      "sender": "staff",
      "staff_name": "Sherry Lim",
      "text": "Hi, I'm Sherry. Try taking your phone out of its case and hold the passport still.",
      "time": "2026-11-06T00:49:26.472Z"
    },
    {
      "session_id": "s1793926166132_1",
      "handoff_no": 1,
      "page_id": "account.step3",
      "sender": "customer",
      "staff_name": null,
      "text": "Still failing. My passport is [hidden]",
      "time": "2026-11-06T00:49:26.475Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

item.description:

**Example payload received:**

}
```

item.name: Ai
item.description:
The AI service on port 3001. The backend calls it from **Deva → Ask the AI**; these requests call it directly, to test it on its own.

In Docker, port 3001 is internal only, so these requests reach it only when you run it yourself: in `ai-agent/`, `node server.js` (Ollama must be running). `{{aiUrl}}` is `http://localhost:3001`.

The backend fills in `step`, `stepTitle`, `lastError`, `wording` and `language` from the database; the browser never sends them.

request.description:
Required: `question` (1–300 characters) and `step` (1–6). Optional: `stepTitle`, `lastError`, `wording` (standard / simple), `language` (en / zh / ms).

`fallback: true` means *offer a person*. `type: preference_change` must be confirmed by the applicant before it's applied. Answer text depends on the model, so yours will differ from the examples.

body.raw:
{
  "question": "Why does the chip scan keep failing?",
  "step": 3,
  "stepTitle": "Scan your passport chip",
  "lastError": "NFC_READ_FAILED",
  "wording": "simple",
  "language": "en"
}

response.name: Answer

  "question": "Why does the chip scan keep failing?",
  "step": 3,
  "stepTitle": "Scan your passport chip",
  "lastError": "NFC_READ_FAILED",
  "wording": "simple",
  "language": "en"
}

  "type": "ai_answer",

  "requires_confirmation": false,
  "fallback": false

item.name: REST
item.description: The staff console's calls.

request.description: Friction events per page and type, for the charts. Totals only. Reload it when `insights:update` arrives.

One row per session that asked for help: live sessions first, newest first. `limit` 1–200, default 50.

- `status`: waiting / active / resolved (this session's latest request)
- `outcome`: in_progress → Pending, submitted → Solved, abandoned / not_eligible → Unable to Solve
- `wait_s`, `help_s`: seconds (null until it happens)

Reload it when `insights:update` arrives.

item.name: Socket.IO · send
item.description: Messages the console sends. Connect a Socket.IO request to `{{baseUrl}}` first.

item.name: send · join_console
item.description:
Send once after connecting (and after a reconnect). Joins the `console` room.

**Send** (event name `join_console`): no message.

**Then:** you get `handoff:queue` with every open request.

item.name: send · handoff:accepted
item.description:
**Pick Up Chat.** The first staff member to send this gets the chat.

**Send** (event name `handoff:accepted`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "staff_name": "Sherry Lim"
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Picked up | `{"ok": true}` |
| Someone else got it first | `{"ok": false, "error": "already_taken"}` |
| No open request | `{"ok": false, "error": "not_open"}` |

**Then:** the applicant gets `handoff:accepted`; every console gets `handoff:taken`.

item.name: send · handoff:message
item.description:
Staff → applicant chat message. 1–300 characters, masked like the applicant's.

**Send** (event name `handoff:message`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "text": "Hi, I'm Sherry. Try taking your phone out of its case and hold the passport still."
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Sent | `{"ok": true}` |
| Not picked up yet | `{"ok": false, "error": "not_picked_up"}` |
| No open request | `{"ok": false, "error": "not_open"}` |
| Empty text | `{"ok": false, "error": "bad_text"}` |

**Then:** the applicant and every console get `handoff:message`.

item.name: send · handoff:resolved
item.description:
**Resolve & Close.**

**Send** (event name `handoff:resolved`, type JSON, Ack on):
```json
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}"
}
```

**Ack examples**

| When | Ack |
|---|---|
| Closed | `{"ok": true}` |
| Already closed | `{"ok": false, "error": "not_open"}` |

**Then:** the applicant and every console get `handoff:resolved`.
